title: PA Timelines — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The dates of one stage of a period's appraisal — planning, mid-year review, year-end review. A period can have each stage once.

The performance appraisal and PA summary reports use these dates to find the periods that fall in the report's date range. The dates do not stop anyone submitting outside them.

fields.label: PAPeriod
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from PA Period master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The appraisal period.

Example. FY 2026

fields.label: ActivityType
fields.rules: Required. One of: Plan, MidYearReview, AnnualReview, Quarter1Review, Quarter3Review.
fields.html:
What it is. The stage the dates are for.

Example. Mid-Year Review

fields.label: StartDate
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.
